findings.title: Account Management
findings.guidance: Manage system accounts including establishment, activation, modification, and disablement.

findings.title: Access Enforcement
findings.guidance: Control access to CUI based on authorized identities and roles.

findings.title: Information Flow Enforcement
findings.guidance: Control information flow between interconnected systems.

findings.title: Separation of Duties
findings.guidance: Establish separation of duties to prevent malevolent activity without collusion.

findings.title: Least Privilege
findings.guidance: Assign only the minimum privileges required for a user or process to perform its function.

findings.title: Non-Privileged Access
findings.guidance: Ensure privileged users use non-privileged accounts for non-privileged functions.

findings.title: Privileged Functions
findings.guidance: Restrict access to privileged functions and log their execution.

findings.title: Unsuccessful Logon Attempts
findings.guidance: Limit unsuccessful logon attempts and lock accounts automatically.

findings.title: System Use Notification
findings.guidance: Display privacy and security notices before granting access.

findings.title: Device Lock
findings.guidance: Prevent access to systems after inactivity by initiating device locks.

findings.title: Session Termination
findings.guidance: Automatically terminate user sessions after specified conditions.

findings.title: Remote Access Monitoring
findings.guidance: Monitor and control remote access sessions.

findings.title: Remote Access Confidentiality
findings.guidance: Use cryptography to protect the confidentiality of remote access sessions.

findings.title: Remote Access Termination
findings.guidance: Ensure remote access can be terminated upon session completion or after inactivity.

findings.title: Privileged Access via Remote
findings.guidance: Route all remote privileged access through managed access control points.

findings.title: Wireless Access
findings.guidance: Establish usage restrictions and configuration requirements for wireless access.

findings.title: Wireless Access Protection
findings.guidance: Protect wireless access with authentication and encryption.

findings.title: Mobile Device Connections
findings.guidance: Control connection of mobile devices to organizational systems.

findings.title: Encrypted Mobile Storage
findings.guidance: Encrypt CUI on mobile devices and computing platforms.

findings.title: External Systems
findings.guidance: Limit use of organizational systems on external systems (e.g., public kiosks).

findings.title: Public Information
findings.guidance: Limit CUI on publicly accessible systems.

findings.title: Control CUI Posting
findings.guidance: Limit CUI posting on publicly accessible systems to authorized personnel.

findings.title: Literacy Training
findings.guidance: Provide security awareness training to all system users.

findings.title: Role-Based Training
findings.guidance: Provide specialized training for those with security-significant roles.

findings.title: Training Records
findings.guidance: Maintain records of security training completion.

findings.title: Audit Record Creation
findings.guidance: Create and retain system audit records to enable monitoring and investigation.

findings.title: Audit Content
findings.guidance: Ensure audit records contain sufficient information (Who, what, when, where).

findings.title: Audit Review and Analysis
findings.guidance: Review and analyze audit records for unusual activity.

findings.title: Audit Failure Alerts
findings.guidance: Alert personnel in the event of an audit logging failure.

findings.title: Audit Correlation
findings.guidance: Correlate audit record review across different repositories.

findings.title: Audit Reduction
findings.guidance: Provide audit reduction and report generation capability.

findings.title: Time Stamps
findings.guidance: Use synchronized internal system clocks to generate time stamps.

findings.title: Audit Protection
findings.guidance: Protect audit information from unauthorized access or deletion.

findings.title: Audit Management
findings.guidance: Limit management of audit functions to authorized personnel.

findings.title: Baseline Configuration
findings.guidance: Establish and maintain baseline configurations of organizational systems.

findings.title: Configuration Change Control
findings.guidance: Track, review, approve, and log changes to organizational systems.

findings.title: Security Configuration Settings
findings.guidance: Establish and enforce security configuration settings.

findings.title: Inventory Management
findings.guidance: Maintain an inventory of system components.

findings.title: Least Functionality
findings.guidance: Configure systems to provide only essential capabilities.

findings.title: Software Blacklisting
findings.guidance: Identify and prohibit unauthorized software.

findings.title: Least Privilege (Config)
findings.guidance: Restrict access to configuration settings to authorized personnel.

findings.title: User-Installed Software
findings.guidance: Establish and enforce policies regarding user-installed software.

findings.title: System Component Integrity
findings.guidance: Control and monitor user-installed software.

findings.title: Identifier Management
findings.guidance: Uniquely identify system users, processes, and devices.

findings.title: Multi-Factor Authentication
findings.guidance: Implement MFA for local and network access.

findings.title: MFA Replay Protection
findings.guidance: Use MFA resistant to replay attacks.

findings.title: Password Complexity
findings.guidance: Enforce minimum password complexity.

findings.title: Identifier Reuse
findings.guidance: Prevent reuse of identifiers for a defined period.

findings.title: Authenticator Management
findings.guidance: Manage authenticators for users and devices.

findings.title: Authenticator Feedback
findings.guidance: Obscure feedback of authentication information.

findings.title: Cryptographic Strength
findings.guidance: Use strong cryptography for authentication.

findings.title: Non-Privileged Accounts
findings.guidance: Prohibit direct login for privileged accounts.

findings.title: Session Cache
findings.guidance: Store and transmit only cryptographically protected authenticators.

findings.title: Password Protection
findings.guidance: Protect passwords at rest and in transit.

findings.title: Incident Handling
findings.guidance: Establish operational incident-handling capability.

findings.title: Incident Reporting
findings.guidance: Track, document, and report incidents.

findings.title: Incident Testing
findings.guidance: Test the organizational incident response capability.

findings.title: System Maintenance
findings.guidance: Perform periodic and timely maintenance.

findings.title: Maintenance Tools
findings.guidance: Inspect and approve maintenance tools.

findings.title: Remote Maintenance
findings.guidance: Sanitize equipment removed for off-site maintenance.

findings.title: Maintenance Logs
findings.guidance: Check media containing diagnostic programs for malicious code.

findings.title: Remote Maintenance Auth
findings.guidance: Require MFA for all remote maintenance sessions.

findings.title: Media Storage
findings.guidance: Physically control and securely store CUI media.

findings.title: Media Access
findings.guidance: Limit access to CUI on system media.

findings.title: Media Sanitization
findings.guidance: Sanitize or destroy system media containing CUI.

findings.title: Media Transport
findings.guidance: Protect media during transport outside of controlled areas.

findings.title: Cryptographic Protection
findings.guidance: Implement cryptographic mechanisms for digital media.

findings.title: Media Marking
findings.guidance: Mark media with necessary CUI labels.

findings.title: Screening
findings.guidance: Screen individuals prior to authorizing access.

findings.title: Termination
findings.guidance: Ensure systems are disabled upon termination.

findings.title: Physical Access Control
findings.guidance: Limit physical access to systems.

findings.title: Monitoring
findings.guidance: Monitor physical access to organizational systems.

findings.title: Visitor Logs
findings.guidance: Maintain audit logs of physical access.

findings.title: Visitor Control
findings.guidance: Control and manage physical access devices.

findings.title: Access Devices
findings.guidance: Manage physical access devices.

findings.title: Alternate Work Sites
findings.guidance: Enforce safeguards at alternate work sites.

findings.title: Risk Identification
findings.guidance: Periodically assess risk to organizational operations.

findings.title: Vulnerability Scanning
findings.guidance: Scan for vulnerabilities in organizational systems.

findings.title: Risk Response
findings.guidance: Remediate vulnerabilities in accordance with risk assessments.

findings.title: Security Plans
findings.guidance: Develop and update System Security Plans (SSP).

findings.title: Control Assessment
findings.guidance: Assess controls to determine if they are effective.

findings.title: Continuous Monitoring
findings.guidance: Monitor security controls on an ongoing basis.

findings.title: Plans of Action
findings.guidance: Develop Plans of Action and Milestones (POAM).

findings.title: Boundary Protection
findings.guidance: Monitor and control communications boundaries.

findings.title: Security Engineering
findings.guidance: Employ architectural designs and security engineering principles.

findings.title: Role Separation
findings.guidance: Separate user functionality from system management functionality.

findings.title: Shared Resources
findings.guidance: Prevent unauthorized information transfer via shared resources.

findings.title: Denial of Service
findings.guidance: Protect against denial of service attacks.

findings.title: IP Restrictions
findings.guidance: Prevent IP spoofing.

findings.title: Transmission Confidentiality
findings.guidance: Protect the confidentiality of transmitted CUI.

findings.title: Key Management
findings.guidance: Establish and manage cryptographic keys.

findings.title: Session Authenticity
findings.guidance: Protect the authenticity of communications sessions.

findings.title: Collaborative Computing
findings.guidance: Prohibit remote activation of collaborative computing devices.

findings.title: Mobile Code
findings.guidance: Control and monitor the use of mobile code.

findings.title: VoIP
findings.guidance: Prohibit use of VoIP technologies unless specified.

findings.title: Session Protection
findings.guidance: Protect the authenticity of communications sessions.

findings.title: Data at Rest
findings.guidance: Protect the confidentiality of CUI at rest.

findings.title: Flaw Remediation
findings.guidance: Identify, report, and correct system flaws.

findings.title: Malicious Code Protection
findings.guidance: Update malicious code protection mechanisms.

findings.title: System Monitoring
findings.guidance: Monitor system to detect attacks.

findings.title: Indicators of Compromise
findings.guidance: Monitor for indicators of compromise.

findings.title: System Scanning
findings.guidance: Perform periodic scans of the system.

findings.title: Security Alerts
findings.guidance: Receive and act upon security alerts.

findings.title: File Integrity Monitoring
findings.guidance: Perform file integrity monitoring.
